free_tier.stated: no free tier: an Inference or Platform key is required and every model is priced per 1M tokens in input / cache read / output columns

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: an OpenAI-compatible key at api.doubleword.ai/v1; add include=pricing to the models endpoint to see tariffs
chaining: pairs with an OpenAI-compatible agent on a paid per-token basis; no standing free route

limits.value: per-1M-token input / cache read / output rates for every model; no free allowance listed

binding_note: no free token allowance, so payment binds first

identity_cost.detail: an Inference or Platform API key is required; no card or phone field is stated on the models and pricing page

reliability_note: no reliability event stated on the first-party page

evidence.proved: pricing is per token with no free allowance
evidence.quote: Doubleword Batch API is priced per model based on token usage. Costs are calculated separately for input tokens (the content you send) and output tokens (the content generated by the model).

notes: models page is a price catalog only; no free tier is published.
